en-US.name: PixPin (Beta)
en-US.publisher: Shenzhen Shendu Tujing Technology Co., Ltd.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Feature changes
- [Annotation] Added solid fill for mosaic and automatic mosaic, with customizable fill colors.
- [Pins] Added “Hide Selected Pins,” including multiple pins at once. The default shortcut is B.
- [Pins] Pin groups can be sorted by creation time or name in ascending or descending order.
Improvements
- [Long screenshot] Automatically excludes the toolbar on supported systems, reducing toolbar repositioning while scrolling.
- [Save] Uses the folder name to name new path tabs automatically.
- [Settings] Added “Remember window size” to text recognition and save windows.
- [Editing] Automatically remembers the window size when closed.
- [Interface] Improved support for Esc and system window-closing shortcuts in feature windows.
- [Annotation] Shows a bounds mask while adjusting a rectangular blur annotation, restoring the blur when the mouse is released.
Bug fixes
- [Save] Fixed incorrect save paths and file names when pasting file URLs.
- [Pins] Fixed a failure message still appearing after canceling a long text pin.
- [Long screenshot] Fixed incorrect mask sizes on secondary displays on macOS.
- [Long screenshot] Fixed reduced sharpness in high-resolution display areas when capturing across displays on macOS.
- [Interface] Fixed floating notifications stealing application focus on macOS.
Membership
- [Translation] Added “Original and translated images” mode with synchronized zooming and dragging.
- [Document recognition] Added support for long screenshots.
- [Document recognition] Added “Remove formula spaces.”
- [Translation, formula recognition, table recognition, document recognition] Added “Remember window size.”
- [Translation] Corrected some source image text selection areas that did not align with the text.
- Membership Fixed member feature dialogs being covered by screenshot or pin windows.

zh-CN.description: 功能强大使用简单的截图/贴图工具，帮助你提高效率
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
功能变化
-【标注】马赛克和自动马赛克新增纯色填充模式，支持自定义填充颜色。
-【贴图】新增“隐藏选中贴图”功能，支持批量隐藏，默认快捷键为 B。
-【贴图】贴图组支持按创建时间或名称正序、倒序排列。
优化
-【长截图】在支持的系统上自动排除工具栏，减少滚动过程中工具栏的位置变化。
-【保存】创建路径标签时，自动使用目录名填写标签名称。
-【设置】文字识别和保存窗口新增“记忆窗口尺寸”选项。
-【编辑】自动记忆上次关闭时的窗口尺寸。
-【界面】完善各功能窗口对 Esc 和系统关闭快捷键的支持。
-【标注】调整矩形模糊标注时显示范围遮罩，松开鼠标后显示模糊效果。
问题修复
-【保存】修复粘贴文件 URL 时，保存路径和文件名识别不正确的问题。
-【贴图】修复取消长文本贴图后仍显示失败提示的问题。
-【长截图】修复 macOS 副屏遮罩尺寸异常的问题。
-【长截图】修复 macOS 跨屏采集时，高分辨率屏幕区域清晰度降低的问题。
-【界面】修复 macOS 浮动提示弹出时抢占应用焦点的问题。
会员相关
-【翻译】新增“原图译图”对照模式，支持同步缩放和拖动查看。
-【文档识别】支持识别长截图。
-【文档识别】新增“去除公式空格”选项。
-【翻译、公式识别、表格识别、文档识别】新增“记忆窗口尺寸”选项。
-【翻译】修正部分原图文字选择区域与实际文字位置不一致的问题。
-【会员】修复会员功能弹窗被截图、贴图窗口遮挡的问题。
